title: CRISPR/Cas9 system-mediated p21 knockout impairs the MITF signaling pathway.
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用CRISPR/Cas9敲除p21并观察MITF信号通路变化，虽涉及蛋白结构预测但核心是基因敲除与表型分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The CRISPR/Cas9 method facilitates targeted disruption of gene sequences, providing a reliable means to analyze gene-dependent regulatory pathways. This study aims to investigate melanogenesis in p21-knockout B16F1 cells generated by the CRISPR/Cas9 system. The mutation was confirmed by DNA Sanger sequencing, which identified frameshift-inducing indels in the p21 locus. The protein structure of p21 in KO cells was predicted by the alpha-Fold2 and ChimeraX models. The expression level of the p21 gene was completely reduced in RT-PCR and qPCR assays. Notably, while p21-knockout cells exhibited significantly reduced SA-beta-galactosidase activity, this was not indicative of cellular rejuvenation. Instead, it correlated with a loss of melanocytic functionality, as evidenced by the concurrent decrease in melanin synthesis and collagen production. Western blotting and immunofluorescence analyses were performed to examine cell cycle and melanogenesis-associated proteins in p21-deficient cells. Loss of p21 resulted in reduced expression of p21, phosphorylated p21, p53, acetylated p53, CDK2, Cyclin D, Cyclin E, MITF, TRP-1, TRP-2, TYR, and p-ERK. Collectively, these findings indicate that p21 is essential for maintaining MITF-driven melanogenic signaling.
abstract_zh: CRISPR/Cas9方法能够实现基因序列的靶向破坏，为分析基因依赖性调控通路提供了可靠手段。本研究旨在利用CRISPR/Cas9系统生成的p21敲除B16F1细胞中探究黑色素生成。通过DNA Sanger测序确认了突变，该测序鉴定出p21位点中诱导移码的插入缺失（indels）。通过alpha-Fold2和ChimeraX模型预测了KO细胞中p21的蛋白质结构。在RT-PCR和qPCR检测中，p21基因的表达水平完全降低。值得注意的是，尽管p21敲除细胞表现出显著降低的SA-β-半乳糖苷酶活性，但这并不表明细胞年轻化。相反，它与黑色素细胞功能的丧失相关，这通过黑色素合成和胶原蛋白产生的同步减少得到证实。进行了Western blotting和免疫荧光分析，以检查p21缺陷细胞中的细胞周期和黑色素生成相关蛋白。p21的缺失导致p21、磷酸化p21、p53、乙酰化p53、CDK2、Cyclin D、Cyclin E、MITF、TRP-1、TRP-2、TYR和p-ERK的表达减少。总体而言，这些发现表明p21对于维持MITF驱动的黑色素生成信号传导至关重要。
